name: better-code-review-graph
description: Knowledge graph for token-efficient code reviews -- semantic search and call-graph resolution across your codebase.

EMBEDDING_MODELS.title: Embedding model selection (optional)
EMBEDDING_MODELS.description: CSV 'provider/model,...'; selects the first entry without runtime fallback. Empty = local fastretrieval registry. Example: cohere/embed-v4.0 (paid; exact 1024 dimensions).

LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL.title: Local embedding model (optional)
LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Built-in fastretrieval model ID, or a local directory containing fastretrieval-manifest.json. External IDs require LOCAL_EMBEDDING_DIM.

LOCAL_RERANK_MODEL.title: Local reranker model (optional)
LOCAL_RERANK_MODEL.description: Fastretrieval TextCrossEncoder model ID; empty = reranking disabled.

LOCAL_EMBEDDING_DIM.title: Local embedding dimension
LOCAL_EMBEDDING_DIM.description: Required output dimension for an external LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL ID without a manifest.

LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_FILE.title: Local embedding model file
LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_FILE.description: ONNX file path inside a manifest-backed local artifact directory.

LOCAL_EMBEDDING_POOLING.title: Local embedding pooling
LOCAL_EMBEDDING_POOLING.description: Explicit pooling for an external ID without a manifest: CLS, MEAN, LAST_TOKEN, or DISABLED.

LOCAL_EMBEDDING_NORMALIZE.title: Normalize local embeddings
LOCAL_EMBEDDING_NORMALIZE.description: Apply explicit L2 normalization for an external ID without a manifest.

SUMMARY_MODELS.title: Summarizer model chain (optional)
SUMMARY_MODELS.description: CSV 'provider/model,...' for graph summarize; selects the first entry without runtime fallback. Empty = summaries disabled. Example: openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3:free

EMBEDDING_API_BASE.title: Embedding endpoint (optional)
EMBEDDING_API_BASE.description: Provider-compatible endpoint or CF AI Gateway embedding URL; SSRF-guarded.

LLM_API_BASE.title: Completion endpoint (optional)
LLM_API_BASE.description: Provider-compatible base URL or CF AI Gateway OpenRouter route; SSRF-guarded.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.title: OpenRouter API key (optional)
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Credential for explicitly selected openrouter/ completion models.

JINA_AI_API_KEY.title: Jina AI API key (optional)
JINA_AI_API_KEY.description: Credential for explicitly selected jina_ai/ embedding models. An empty EMBEDDING_MODELS selection uses local ONNX; keys alone do not select cloud. https://jina.ai/api-dashboard/

GEMINI_API_KEY.title: Gemini API key (optional)
GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Enables gemini/ models referenced in EMBEDDING_MODELS / SUMMARY_MODELS. Free tier available. https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

OPENAI_API_KEY.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Enables openai/ models referenced in EMBEDDING_MODELS / SUMMARY_MODELS. https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

COHERE_API_KEY.title: Cohere API key (optional)
COHERE_API_KEY.description: Enables cohere/ embedding models referenced in EMBEDDING_MODELS. https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys
